recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: Where does your partner dream of living?
Which country would they visit first?
City or countryside: where would they live?
What would they buy first after a lottery win?
A skill they dream of learning?
Which famous person would they love to meet?
What do they want to be doing in ten years?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Dreams edition: 8 questions about your partner's biggest dreams. Do you know them?

Comment your score!
